explanation.headline: FDA's records show the metoclopramide hydrochloride supply chain relies on multiple plants with VAI inspection histories; no OAI or warning letters are recorded for the registered sites

sentences.text: The product label (SPL set 95269b1f) lists five registered plants for metoclopramide hydrochloride NDC 72089030715: ACM Pharma (France), COSMA S.p.A. (Italy), Intertek (UK), Patheon France SAS (France), and SGS France (France) [E7, E12, E17, E23, E25].

FDA inspection records for each plant show only Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications across the most recent inspections: ACM Pharma VAI on 2024-01-24 [E6], COSMA S.p.A. VAI on 2022-06-17 [E11], Intertek VAI on 2023-06-30 [E16], Patheon France SAS VAI on 2023-09-29 [E22], and SGS France VAI on 2024-01-19 [E24].
No Official Action Indicated (OAI) classifications, warning letters, or import alerts appear in the provided FDA records for any of these facilities.
Corvale East holds 44 units with 5 days on hand at 8.9 units per day [D1], while Corvale General holds 257 units with 29 days on hand at 8.8 units per day [D2].

Because the evidence links are weak and no FDA enforcement action explains the shortage, verify current allocation status with the manufacturer (Evoke Pharma, Inc.) and confirm whether any recent supply interruptions have been reported for NDC 72089030715.

rejected.text: The rule-based transfer option moves 82 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, leaving Corvale General with approximately two weeks of supply and bringing Corvale East to approximately 14 days on hand.
rejected.reason: number 82 is not in the cited evidence

Q-f1f8d1.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-9e829a.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('95269b1f-779c-4ca0-9f86-e74e677f9900') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-2348e3.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-24d67a.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-5b8d4a.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%spray%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-cc3f62.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3004177283', '3002806754', '3002807539', '3004468553', '3002807507') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-f7ee8f.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3004177283', '3002806754', '3002807539', '3004468553', '3002807507') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-6b67d1.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3004177283', '3002806754', '3002807539', '3004468553', '3002807507') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('acm', 'cosma s p a', 'cosma', 'intertek', 'melbourn scientific trading intertek melbourn', 'patheon france', 'patheon france s a s', 'sgs france')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-d3df0f.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('acm', 'cosma s p a', 'cosma', 'intertek', 'melbourn scientific trading intertek melbourn', 'patheon france', 'patheon france s a s', 'sgs france', 'evoke') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-a1cb5b.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('72089030715')
